scripts.build: npm run generate:types && cargo build --manifest-path contracts/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test:unit: cargo test --manifest-path contracts/Cargo.toml && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:integration: npm run migrate:up -w backend && npm run migrate:down -w backend -- --count 3 && npm run migrate:up -w backend
